title: SAF-Predict: Descriptor-Based Physicochemical Property Prediction for Hydrocarbon Fuel Candidates
description: Version 1.0.0 of SAF-Predict. The archived repository contains an offline browser predictor, trained model artifacts, a 300-record development set, a 10-record structurally stratified internal held-out test set, record-property provenance, reference metadata, grouped nested-cross-validation artifacts, and scripts for descriptor verification, training, export, and held-out evaluation. Code is MIT-licensed. Project-authored data curation is offered under CC BY 4.0 to the extent rights are held; third-party source material is not relicensed and remains subject to original source terms. The held-out set is not independent external validation, and the solid-liquid phase-transition model requires experimental confirmation.
